mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, let’s bring all these ideas together and think about what they really mean for you. Belonging isn’t simple—it’s a winding path, shaped by contradictions and the push and pull of figuring out who we are. And feminism? It’s not about being flawless. It’s about being honest, about growing, and about giving yourself the room to stumble and get back up. Pop culture isn’t just something we watch or listen to—it’s a mirror, reflecting who we are, while also nudging us to see what could be different. It’s okay to enjoy it and still question it at the same time. Intersectionality reminds us that every story comes loaded with its own mix of challenges and strengths. That’s what makes each journey so unique—and so important. Community matters. Solidarity isn’t just a buzzword—it's what helps us keep going, together, even when the work feels tough. And those small acts of hope or resistance you might think are too little? They’re not. They add up, especially when change feels slow. The road through “Bad Feminist” isn’t straight or simple. It’s messy, full of doubts, laughter, tough questions, and that quiet bravery to keep moving forward. You don’t have to be perfect to make an impact. You don’t need all the answers to belong. What matters most is showing up, listening, caring, and never stopping your learning. The world’s always going to be a little bit chaotic—and so are we. But that’s where real growth and connection can happen. If you ever find yourself tangled in your own contradictions, just remember—you’re not alone. The work of justice is hard, but it’s also full of hope, humor, and the promise of something better. So, let yourself be a “bad feminist.” Be imperfect, be curious, be real. The world needs your story, your voice, and your willingness to keep trying. Progress doesn’t come from people who never falter—it comes from those who choose to keep going, one imperfect step at a time. Keep moving forward. Your journey matters.
